name: What is the process for kitchen cabinet installation with Maine Results, Inc.?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for kitchen cabinet installation with Maine Results, Inc.?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process for kitchen cabinet installation with Maine Results, Inc. typically begins with an initial consultation and design phase, where we discuss your needs, preferences, and budget. This is followed by detailed measurements and cabinet ordering. Once cabinets arrive, our team will prepare the space, carefully remove old cabinetry if applicable, and then meticulously install the new units, ensuring proper alignment and fit. The final steps include installing hardware and performing a thorough cleanup and inspection. We communicate every step to ensure transparency and client satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our cabinet installation process involves consultation, design, measurements, ordering, professional installation, hardware fitting, cleanup, and final inspection.
